controls.name: widthPct
controls.doc: The stereo width, percent: the side (L - R)/2 times widthPct/100 over the mid (L + R)/2. 0 is mono, 100 the input bit for bit (the come-up value), 200 the side doubled.

controls.name: pseudo
controls.doc: A pseudo-stereo for a mono source, in the order of the integer the kernel reads: off; comb, the complementary comb L = M + g M[n - d], R = M - g M[n - d] with g WIDTH_COMB_GAIN, whose mono sum is the mid exactly; haas, the right leg delayed by pseudoMs. Off comes up.

controls.name: pseudoMs
controls.doc: The pseudo-stereo's delay d, ms, rounded to the nearest sample.

controls.name: bassMono
controls.doc: Whether the low end is summed to mono: on splits the side with a Linkwitz-Riley crossover at bassMonoHz (omx_xover, LR4) and keeps its high band only, the mid through the crossover's all-pass so the bands stay in phase. Off comes up.
controls.why: Provisional, not ruled (omx-dsp#188): bass mono as a switch of its own beside bassMonoHz is the design's proposal. The value ships as declared until the ruling.

controls.name: bassMonoHz
controls.doc: Where the low end goes mono, Hz: the crossover's corner.

WIDTH_COMB_GAIN.doc: The complementary comb's gain g: its legs ripple between 1 - g and 1 + g, 0.5 a +3.5 / -6 dB comb, the mono sum unmoved.
WIDTH_COMB_GAIN.why: Provisional, not ruled (omx-dsp#188): the comb's gain of 0.5 is the design's proposal. The value ships as declared until the ruling.

WIDTH_MAX_DELAY_MS.doc: The longest pseudo-stereo delay, ms: pseudoMs' top, the delay omx_width_delay holds to, the ring sized for it at 192 kHz.
